_meta_itemized.notes: Douglas Clyde, County Council, 2020 Pre-Election (general). A HANDWRITTEN bare cover: one page, no schedules attached, signed 10/25/20. THE ZERO-GLYPH RULING IS VISIBLE HERE ON THE COVER, which is where the cover tranche already found Clyde's two deliberate slashed zeros: this page carries FOUR of them - all three Total contributions cells (Current / Last / Cumulative) and the Current Report expenditure cell - each a hand-drawn slashed zero with a horizontal stroke through it, an affirmative written zero and not an empty or dashed cell. They are already published as 0 by the cover tranche with the glyph preserved, and no ledger row in this record depends on them. The cover's three-column arithmetic closes cleanly and identifies the period grain without ambiguity: expenditures Current = 0, Last Report = 277.38, Cumulative = 277.38, and campaign balance -277.38 in all three columns, i.e. the candidate reported NO activity at all in the pre-general period and carried forward the 277.38 already reported on his earlier 2020 filing (the sibling 12941, itemized in this same chunk). A negative campaign balance sustained across all three columns is itself a source property worth noting - the filer spent his own money and never recorded a reimbursing contribution. The party line is struck through in pen. Nothing about this filing is a data gap to be filled: the county published exactly one page and that page is complete on its own terms.
